tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.lift: Hold it on a creature in reach: it floats where you point, and falls when you let go. Too heavy for bosses.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.gust: A cone of wind that throws creatures back. Aim at your feet and it throws you up, and your fall is forgiven.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.zip: Shoots a line at the block you look at and pulls you to it. The fall after is forgiven.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.rewind: Takes you back to where you stood three seconds ago, with the health you had then if it was more, and puts out any fire on you.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.frost: Hold it for a cone of cold that slows and freezes, turns water to melting ice and puts out fire.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.smother: Wraps a creature in reach in smoke: it is blinded and slowed, and chokes if it breathes.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.sonic: A cone of sound that hurts, knocks back, breaks off whatever its targets were doing and shatters glass panes.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.parry: Raise it like a shield. A blow from in front, met in the first moment of the guard, is turned aside and its striker reels. It wears with each parry.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.chain: Hooks a creature in reach and yanks it to you. Too heavy for bosses.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.growth: For half a minute you grow bigger, tougher and stronger, with a longer reach. Then you are worn out for a while. Use it again to stop early.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.ki: Fires a bolt of stored force at what you aim at.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.blink: Puts you where you look, up to twelve blocks away.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.climb: Hold them in either hand and climb any wall you push into. They wear as you climb.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.fireburst: Spits three small fireballs where you aim.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.beam: Hold it on a creature for two seconds and a beam burns it.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.fangs: A line of snapping jaws bursts out of the ground ahead of you.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.blast: Throw it: it hisses, then bursts. The charge is used up.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.mimic.potion: Throws the splash or lingering potion in your other hand twice as far as a hand can. The potion is used up.
